verdict.rationale: RudderStack's docs list a dedicated HTTP API for sending event data from a source to connected destinations, plus a Pixel API for GET-based tracking when POST isn't feasible. That covers the documented server-to-server ingestion endpoint. Nothing in the pack covers how requests are authenticated or what delivery guarantees apply (retries, at-least-once semantics, deduplication), and no hands-on use of the HTTP API is evidenced. Missing for 10: authentication mechanism (e.g. write key or basic auth), documented delivery guarantees and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration of the HTTP API.
